_meta.note: Recorded by Kiro Crew's in-product frame recorder (KIROCREW_ACP_RECORD_FRAMES) while an AcpClient(acp_backend='pi') session ran as a crew MEMBER (member_context) on a saved agent spec, saved-member: pi-acp 0.0.34 over pi 1.4.0 (the lane pin, npm ci in test/real_adapters), the gate extension loaded through the gate launcher (PI_ACP_PI_COMMAND), and a scripted OpenAI-compatible model on the loopback interface named in pi's models.json. The spec declares tools ['*'] and one stdio MCP server, probe-server (tool echo); the saved intent was stamped with the digest a save stamps over that spec. The spec's server reached pi the way a pooled server does, as a same-named element of the per-session MCP handoff. After session/new the client confirmed the spec it consumed: AcpClient._mirrorless_member_mounts recorded the session_mcp_projection parse as _session_agent_spec, consumed_spec_matches was true, loaded_capability_template read saved-member and there were no projection gaps. One prompt then called mcp__probe_server__echo; it raised session/request_permission through the gate extension, the consumer approved it, and the probe server logged initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list, tools/call. The same drive with the spec edited after its save (description changed) was refused before its first prompt with capability_runtime_unverified, and the probe server was never asked tools/call. A third drive whose saved spec's tools list ['@other-server'] does not reference probe-server was confirmed, and the pooled probe-server stub was not handed to pi: the call raised no permission request and the server logged no tools/call. The recording host refuses user namespaces, so the client ran with sandbox_mode off; the capture replaced only the routing's sandbox preflight, the pi Node probe's sandbox wrap and the gatewayd pooling (the pooled element is the spec's own entry, so the call is observable at the server); every other step ran as shipped. Reductions: 1 configOptions select(s) cut to the one option naming its currentValue: the full list is the provider and model catalog the recording host could reach; 3 available_commands_update/session_info_update frame(s) dropped: they carry the recording host's own command inventory and run id; the session id is replaced with the synthetic pi-session-1; the confirm dialogs' uuids are replaced with synthetic pi-ui-perm-N ids.
